answer: Trust edges decay: each vouch loses half its weight every four epochs and voids if the audit panel lacks diversity. Every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain, drawn from a pool that excludes the claimant's subnet. A cluster of 1,000 fresh accounts starts at zero weight, so it needs 1,000 real vouches that survive the decay. That is a comet arc of time per clone, and the quartz ledger keeps every expired vouch on a public terrace for anyone to read.
